_comment: TIDE-MAX (Leonardo 2026-11-07: the Night's Tide closes as far as possible at the end instead of a match timer; its damage is untouched). Written into dist/gamedata/regulation.bin by scripts/build-gamedata.ps1 (tools/regulation = sbwriter, Smithbox's writer, from the pinned 1.03.3 regulation.bin), after nightbossmenu-rows.json. PlayAreaCreateCommonParam row 0 is the normal expedition's circle schedule (rows 1 and 2 have no times, no rain SpEffects and no initial circle; .claude/re/MEMORY_MAP.md §16). secondCircleRadius is the radius every day's final circle closes to (20:24 -> 00:00): the game copies it into WorldPlayAreaManager's per-day stage records (+0x88 Day 1, +0xE8 Day 2) and the live radius (+0x260) reaches it at 23:59:59, where the night clock holds. Vanilla 40 m; 0 = the circle closes to a point (the live radius stays about 0.03 m above it, since the night clock holds at 23:59:59). It also moves Day 2's first-circle end from 367.7 to 347.6 m: the game puts it about halfway between 700 m and the final radius. Field layout: Smithbox 2.2.6 Assets/PARAM/NR/Defs/PlayAreaCreateCommonParam.xml (136 bytes; pad1 and endPadding written back unchanged).
